topic: The Uncertainty Principle: The Fourier Trade-off

sections.title: Intuitive Hook: The Musical Note
lecture_lines: Signals exist in time or frequency.
animations: Create a single sine wave using #FFFFFF color.
Fade in a frequency label #FF0000 near the peak.
Scale the wave to visualize higher frequency. Change the frequency label color to #00FF00.

sections.title: Mathematical Prerequisite: The Fourier Transform
lecture_lines: Fourier Transform acts like a prism.
It reveals constituent frequencies of signals.
animations: Display formula f(t) = ∫ F(ω)e^iωt dω in #FFFFFF.

sections.title: The Core Concept: The Reciprocal Relationship
lecture_lines: Time and frequency widths are reciprocal.
Widths are linked by a constant.
This is an inherent wave property.
animations: Show two bars: time width and frequency width in #FFFFFF.
When one bar shrinks, expand the other in #FF00FF.
Show a product label constant in #00FF00.
Animate both bars changing together in synchronization.

sections.title: Physical Application: Heisenberg’s Analogy
lecture_lines: Position and momentum face this constraint.
animations: Draw a position wave packet in #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Summary & Reflection
lecture_lines: Fourier links signals to quantum physics.
animations: Display text 'Time and Frequency are reciprocals' in #FFFFFF.
Animate the text color to #FFFF00 for emphasis.
